visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a young woman smiling. She wears a vibrant green baseball cap with white embroidery, dark oversized sunglasses, and a white t-shirt. The woman stands in front of large glass windows revealing a city skyline. She poses energetically with her arms wide. A large potted palm plant sits in a black planter to her right. (3) Close-up shot focusing on her attire. She points to the front of her white graphic t-shirt and the light blue denim overalls she is wearing. Her hair is styled in a single braid over her left shoulder. (4) Detailed close-up of the waist area of her overalls. She uses both hands to pull and display the white drawstrings, demonstrating the cinching feature of the garment. (5) Return to the medium full shot. She poses with one hand on her hip and holds a small green leather handbag in the other, swaying playfully. (6) Close-up of her face as she touches her lips with her finger and then points toward the camera, smiling warmly under her cap. (7) She holds her brown-tinted sunglasses with both hands, bringing them close to the lens to showcase the frame and lens color. (8) Focus shifts to her silver accessories. She points to a chunky silver earring and then holds a delicate silver necklace chain to highlight them for the viewer. (9) Close-up of the small, bright green handbag held up by its handle, moving slightly to show its texture and design. (10) Final medium full shot. She walks towards the window, turns back to give a final smile and wave, and then walks out of frame towards the plant.
